entries.summary: Sprint 3 frontend: POS screen, order history, invoice viewer. All routes wired. TS build clean.
features_added: POS screen (/pos): product search, cart management, confirm-payment modal
Order history (/orders): paginated list with status/date filters
Invoice list (/invoices): paginated with status filter, cancel action for accountant
Invoice detail (/invoices/:id and /orders/:orderId/invoice): full VAT subtotals view
API hooks: frontend/src/lib/orders.ts + frontend/src/lib/invoices.ts
entries.notes: New routes: /pos, /orders, /orders/:orderId/invoice, /invoices, /invoices/:id. All guarded by RequireAuth.

entries.summary: Sprint 3 backend: Order + Invoice modules. 36 new unit tests. EventEmitter2 inter-module integration.
features_added: Orders module: POST /orders, POST /orders/:id/items, POST /orders/:id/confirm-payment, POST /orders/:id/cancel, GET /orders, GET /orders/:id
Invoices module: GET /invoices, GET /invoices/:id, PATCH /invoices/:id/cancel, GET /orders/:orderId/invoice
Order state machine: pending → processing → completed | cancelled | refunded
Invoice auto-generation via EventEmitter2 on order.processing event
Per-store per-year invoice sequence with FOR UPDATE pessimistic lock
VAT calculation: Math.floor(taxableVnd * rate / 100) — integer VNĐ
3 DB migrations: orders, order_items, invoices + invoice_sequences tables
36 unit tests: orders.service.spec.ts (25 tests) + invoices.service.spec.ts (11 tests)
entries.notes: Added @nestjs/event-emitter to backend deps. EventEmitterModule.forRoot() registered in AppModule.

entries.summary: Critical bugfix: admin storeId null → empty string in JwtStrategy caused UUID crash on all products endpoints.
bugs_fixed: BUG-0004: admin user storeId=null coerced to '' by jwt.strategy.ts ?? '' fallback — PostgreSQL QueryFailedError: invalid input syntax for type uuid: "" on all products and GET /stores/me endpoints
entries.notes: 4-file fix: AuthUser.storeId widened to string|null; jwt.strategy.ts null preserved; ProductsService all public methods guard with ForbiddenException when storeId null; StoresService.findMyStore same guard. TypeScript type-check clean.

entries.summary: Critical bugfix: login envelope unwrap. Users could not access any protected route after login.
bugs_fixed: BUG-0003: TransformInterceptor envelope { data, meta } not unwrapped in api-client.ts — accessToken was always undefined, RequireAuth bounced all authenticated users back to /login
entries.notes: Single-file fix in frontend/src/lib/api-client.ts. Added response interceptor to unwrap backend envelope globally. Also fixed raw axios refresh-token path. Regression risk: low (hasOwnProperty guard).
